aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:873.title: LA Galaxy, Sr Director, Digital Marketing & Product
aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:873.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Sr. Director, Digital Marketing & Product will lead the LA Galaxy's end-to-end digital marketing, fan journey, and digital product strategy, driving acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, and revenue across all digital touchpoints. This role oversees performance marketing, lifecycle marketing and CRM, as well as owned channels including email, SMS, push notifications, website, and mobile app experiences. The position is responsible for building a connected, data-driven fan journey through audience insights, personalization, and optimization strategies that enhance fan engagement and business outcomes. In addition, this leader will own the strategy, roadmap, and performance of the Club's digital product ecosystem, including the website, mobile app, ecommerce, and ticketing experiences, ensuring all digital products effectively support both fan needs and business objectives. The role will lead user experience (UX), conversion rate optimization (CRO), experimentation, and personalization efforts, integrating product strategy with lifecycle, CRM, and performance marketing initiatives to deliver a seamless and engaging fan experience. The Sr. Director will partner closely with Integrated Marketing, Data & Analytics, Creative & Content, Ticketing, and other commercial teams to translate organizational priorities into coordinated digital strategies, product enhancements, and measurable business results. This individual will champion a data-driven, customer-centric approach while continuing to evolve the Club's digital capabilities and in-house marketing operations to maximize growth and fan loyalty. Essential Functions Digital Marketing Strategy & Fan Journey Leads the Club’s integrated digital marketing strategy across paid media, lifecycle/CRM, website and app, creating a connected approach across the fan journey. Develops strategies to acquire new fans, deepen engagement, drive conversion and increase retention and lifetime value. Establishes clear channel roles, audience strategies, measurement frameworks and optimization plans across digital touchpoints. Lifecycle Marketing & CRM Leads lifecycle marketing and CRM strategy across email, SMS, push and other owned channels. Develops audience segmentation, personalization, automation and journey strategies across acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention and renewal. Partners with Data & Analytics to improve fan intelligence, audience development and activation of first-party data. Establishes testing and measurement frameworks to continuously improve engagement, conversion and retention. Paid Media & Performance Marketing Owns paid media strategy and execution across paid search, paid social and emerging channels, with accountability for acquisition, demand generation, revenue and ROI. Leads the continued development of an in-house paid media capability, including team structure, tools, processes and agency relationsh

anacorp-ana-corp:lever:09422548-cf87-432.title: Junior Creative Visual Designer
anacorp-ana-corp:lever:09422548-cf87-432.description: About ANA: Join a recognized industry leader - Alliance North America was proudly named a 2025 Top Workplace in the Manufacturing Industry, an honor based entirely on feedback from our own employees about our culture, values, and workplace experience. Alliance North America was established in 2017 and is proud to be the sole North American supplier of AIRMAN Power Generators, AIRMAN Air Compressors, and ANA’s patented EBOSS® Hybrid Energy System and Smart load bank system. Our commitment to our customers is to Make their World Easier, by answering the phone, understanding their needs, and taking ownership to provide them solutions. With a large parts inventory and more than 90% of all orders shipping within 24 hours, you never have to worry about spare parts. We help keep your fleet in top condition with our world class Support Department, who are always ready to help and be a resource by providing training on our equipment. ANA serves construction, industrial, and equipment rental sectors, as well as utilities, municipalities, and telecom companies. By delivering top-quality equipment, ANA ensures reliability, exceptional performance, and minimal noise levels. Our commitment to innovation, customer-centric solutions, and unwavering excellence drives our growth and success. ANA is the exclusive North American supplier for AIRMAN® mobile generators and air compressors. Additionally, the EBOSS® Hybrid Energy Systems lineup has revolutionized the energy sector with renewable energy storage applications. ANA is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada with locations in Cypress, California and Spartanburg, South Carolina. ANA is growing and scaling and we are seeking a Junior Creative to join the Marketing team in an onsite position in Henderson, NV. As a Junior Creative Designer, you will be responsible for supporting the development and execution of visual design projects from concept to completion. You will collaborate with the creative team to bring innovative ideas to life and ensure that design elements align with project goals and brand standards. Your primary focus will be on creating visually compelling graphics and layouts, improving existing design assets, and contributing to the development of creative solutions that enhance ANA's brand presence and support marketing initiatives. The Junior Creative Designer will assist in the creation and execution of visual designs for various marketing materials, including digital content, print collateral, and branding elements. This entry-level position offers an excellent opportunity for a creative individual to develop their design skills and gain hands-on experience in a supportive and collaborative team environment. The position is fully onsite, and the work schedule is weekdays at 8:00 – 5:00pm. This role reports to the Visual Design Supervisor.
responsibilities: Design Creation: Assist in creating visually engaging designs for a variety of projects, including templates, social media graphics, website visuals, email campaigns, brochures, flyers, and other marketing materials.
Concept Development:  Collaborate with marketing team to brainstorm and develop design concepts that align with project objectives and brand guidelines.
Brand Consistency: Ensure that all design work adheres to the company's brand standards and maintains a consistent visual identity across all platforms and materials.
Feedback Incorporation: Incorporate feedback from team members and stakeholders into design revisions and updates. Demonstrate a willingness to iterate and refine designs based on constructive input.
Project Support: Provide support in the design process, including preparing files for print, resizing assets for different formats, and ensuring timely delivery of design assets.
Trend Awareness: Stay up to date with design trends, tools, and techniques. Bring fresh ideas and innovative approaches to design projects.
Collaboration: Work closely with other team members, including marketers, copywriters, and developers, to ensure designs meet project requirements and deadlines.
Quality Assurance: Review and proofread design work to ensure accuracy, consistency, and high-quality output before final delivery.
Travel up to 10%
Other duties as assigned
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual arts, or a related field is preferred or equivalent practical experience.
1-2 years of experience in a design role, including internships or freelance work, is preferred.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and other design tools.
Strong portfolio showcasing a range of design projects and creative work.
Basic understanding of design principles, typography, color theory, and layout techniques.
Excellent attention to detail with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Ability to take direction and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills and a positive, proactive attitude.

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:a5a435db-aa4.description: Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses, and our growth depends on a steady flow of qualified sales opportunities. We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to be the tip of that spear: the first person prospective customers meet and the engine that keeps our pipeline full. This is a high-energy, high-ownership seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn the craft fast and grow into bigger things. You'll identify companies that are actively hiring for roles Wing can support, reach out with a compelling alternative to traditional hiring, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. It's a great fit for someone who's competitive, well-organized, motivated by clear targets, and genuinely curious about how AI, remote talent, and global workforce solutions are changing the way companies build teams. Generate and Qualify Pipeline Identify companies actively hiring for roles Wing can service, such as Executive Assistants, Admin Assistants, Customer Support, Sales Support, Recruiting Support, Operations Support, and other business support roles. Research target accounts to understand what they are hiring for, why they may need support, and where Wing could be a strong fit. Reach out to prospective customers across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels. Run focused outbound campaigns around hiring signals, job postings, company growth, and operational pain points. Hold early discovery conversations to understand the prospect's hiring needs, pain points, urgency, and openness to remote talent or AI-enabled workforce solutions. Communicate what Wing Assistant does and why it matters clearly enough to earn the next meeting. Book qualified appointments for Account Executives with companies that have a clear need, relevant hiring activity, or a strong use case for Wing. Partner with the Sales Team Work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to build and protect a healthy, well-qualified pipeline. Hand off opportunities cleanly, with the context AEs need to move deals forward. Share key details from discovery calls, including the role the company is hiring for, current hiring process, pain points, timing, budget signals, and decision-makers involved. Keep activity, notes, and pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM. Bring the Market Back In Feed what you're hearing from prospects back to the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams. Help refine messaging and outreach based on what's actually landing with companies. Identify patterns in hiring demand, objections, and industries where Wing is resonating. Suggest new outbound angles based on job postings, hiring trends, and prospect conversations. Core Requirements 1–4+ years in sales, business development, appointment setting, cold calling, recruiting, staffing, or a comparable outbound role. A real interest in B2B sales; bonus points if it's in SaaS, AI, staffing, recruiting, outsourcing, or global workforce operations. Proven background in sales prospecting, cold calling, appointment setting, or high-volume outbound outreach. Strong written and verbal communication; you can get to the point and make it compelling. Comfort reaching out to companies that may not have considered remote assistants, virtual assistants, or offshore talent before. Strong research skills and the ability to turn hiring signals into relevant outbound messaging. Strong organization and the resilience to keep going when a day doesn't go your way. The drive that comes from chasing clear goals, activity metrics, and booked meeting targets. The ability to run your own desk while still collaborating well across teams. A genuine eagerness to learn the product, the industry, and the sales craft quickly. Nice to Have Exposure to staffing companies, recruiting firms, BPOs, outsourcing companies, virtual assistant companies, digital agent companies, or high-ticket professional services organizations. jobgether-jobgether:lever:6068d386-aac9-.title: Project / Product Manager — PSP & Payment Integrations
jobgether-jobgether:lever:6068d386-aac9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project / Product Manager — PSP & Payment Integrations based in Germany. This role is ideal for a hands-on payments professional who understands payment integrations beyond the project-management layer. You will lead the end-to-end integration of PSPs, payment providers, and payment methods, from reviewing API documentation and configuring sandbox environments through testing, production launch, and post-release stabilization. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, QA, business stakeholders, and external payment partners. The role combines delivery ownership with practical knowledge of APIs, transaction flows, authentication, webhooks, and payment operations. You will help shape priorities, manage dependencies, and ensure integrations are delivered reliably and efficiently. This is an environment with significant ownership, international payment infrastructure, and exposure to a broad range of providers and payment methods. Lead end-to-end integrations with new PSPs, payment providers, acquiring partners, and payment methods, from initial technical review through production launch and stabilization. Review API documentation and understand integration flows, including authentication, API keys, signatures, requests/responses, webhooks, callbacks, and transaction statuses. Translate integration requirements into clear, actionable tasks for Development and QA teams. Coordinate credentials, environments, merchant configuration, technical dependencies, blockers, testing activities, and release readiness. Collaborate closely with developers, QA specialists, business stakeholders, and external payment providers to keep integrations on track. Oversee sandbox, staging, and production testing, troubleshooting issues and coordinating post-release stabilization when required. Manage the payment integration backlog in Jira, including Epics, Tasks, dependencies, priorities, and Jira Plans. Plan delivery timelines and team capacity while maintaining visibility of risks, dependencies, and progress. Maintain accurate and accessible integration documentation in Confluence. Contribute to prioritization decisions around payment providers, integrations, and payment methods. Use a practical understanding of payment lifecycles, reconciliation, and financial flows to support effective delivery and issue resolution. Requirements Demonstrated hands-on experience with PSPs, payment gateways, acquiring, or payment processing , with direct involvement in payment provider integrations. Proven experience personally taking payment integrations from provider documentation and technical setup through testing and production launch, rather than managing them only at a high level. Strong understanding of REST APIs, request/response logic, webhooks, callbacks, authentication mechanisms, signatures, and API keys. Practical knowledge of deposits, payouts, transaction statuses, status mapping, sandbox/staging/production environments, error handling, and integration troubleshooting. Understanding of reconciliation and basic financial flows within payment processing. Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery across Product, Development, QA, business teams, and external payment providers. Experience with Jira and Confluence, including backlog management, prioritization, dependencies, documentation, and planning. Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, timelines, and technical dependencies. Ability to independently explain a payment lifecycle and the technical flow of a provider integration. Experience in iGaming, betting, crypto, or forex payments is a strong advantage. Additional experience with payment orchestration, routing, multiple simultaneous PSP integrations, international payments, settlements, fees, reconciliation, or AI tools for analysis, document

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7b246f13-58d4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Infrastructure Application and Database SME based in the United States. This is a fully remote opportunity for a senior technical specialist supporting a federal mission-critical program. The role focuses on providing expert-level guidance across Oracle databases, identity platforms, middleware, analytics, and enterprise infrastructure. You will tackle highly complex technical challenges and develop innovative solutions within a sophisticated government technology environment. Working with executive-level project teams, you will provide technical direction, evaluate alternatives, and influence long-term technology decisions. The position combines hands-on administration, implementation, troubleshooting, systems integration, and technical analysis. You will also contribute to high-quality technical documentation and deliverables supporting federal stakeholders. This role is well suited to an independent, technically strong professional who thrives on solving complex problems and working toward long-term objectives. Provide expert technical support, analysis, research, and problem resolution for complex infrastructure, application, database, and identity-management challenges. Serve as a technical subject matter expert on executive-level project teams, providing technical direction, interpretation, recommendations, and alternative solutions. Administer, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot Oracle Database, Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), Single Sign-On (SSO), Oracle Access Manager (OAM), Oracle Identity Manager (OIM), Oracle Business Intelligence Suite Enterprise Edition (OBIEE), and Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) environments. Support and sustain DoD or federal Oracle identity platforms and associated enterprise technologies. Apply advanced technical principles, theories, concepts, and methodologies to unusually complex technology problems. Develop innovative technical approaches, advanced technology ideas, and solutions that can be translated into effective final products or capabilities. Contribute to architecture, implementation, systems integration, software development methodologies, security engineering, and other relevant IT service areas. Independently determine appropriate courses of action to achieve technical and program objectives while working toward established long-term goals. Collaborate with technical and program stakeholders to evaluate requirements, resolve challenges, and support successful implementation and sustainment. Prepare clear, accurate, and timely technical documentation, reports, and other deliverables for government stakeholders. Apply strong written and verbal communication skills when explaining complex technical issues to technical and non-technical audiences. Maintain high standards of quality, timeliness, and professionalism across all assigned technical deliverables. Requirements: Minimum of 7 years of relevant professional experience in infrastructure, applications, databases, identity management, or related technical domains. Demonstrated experience supporting DoD or federal Oracle Identity products in an OIM, OAM, and SOA-based environment, version 12c or higher. Strong technical knowledge of Oracle enterprise technologies, with hands-on experience administering, implementing, sustaining, and troubleshooting complex platforms. Must possess an IT-II Non-Critical Sensitive security clearance or Tier 3 (T3) clearance prior to onboarding , with a Secret clearance required upon hire . Strong command of the English language, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to analyze exceptionally complex technical problems and develop innovative, practical, and effective solutions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e59782c1-94af-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Manager (Internal HRIS / HR Tech) based in Brazil. This is a product leadership opportunity focused on building and evolving internal HR technology for a global, distributed organization. You will own product discovery, requirements, prioritization, and roadmap decisions across core HRIS capabilities, including Core HR and Time Off. Working closely with Design, AI-assisted Development, and business stakeholders, you will turn complex needs into clear, actionable product requirements. You will play a central role in improving B2B and administrative user experiences while ensuring secure, scalable, and intuitive workflows. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from discovery and design through testing, launch, and user adoption. It is well suited to an independent Product Manager who thrives in fast-paced, highly collaborative, and AI-enabled product environments. Own product discovery, requirements gathering, prioritization, and roadmap development for internal HR technology products. Conduct stakeholder interviews and translate business and user needs into clear product requirements and actionable solutions. Audit existing products and workflows to determine what should be retained, redesigned, or removed. Create and maintain high-quality PRDs, user stories, user flows, acceptance criteria, and detailed product specifications. Own the delivery of core HRIS modules, including Core HR and Time Off. Partner closely with Design and AI-assisted Development teams to maintain a continuous pipeline of ready-to-build requirements. Review Figma designs and ensure proposed solutions align with product requirements and B2B/admin UX standards. Manage the product backlog, priorities, dependencies, and sprint planning using Jira, Linear, or similar tools. Lead User Acceptance Testing, feature validation, and product sign-offs to ensure solutions meet business and user expectations. Coordinate launch readiness activities, including SSO, Slack integrations, data migration, and RBAC/security testing. Drive products through discovery, development, production go-live, and user adoption. Gather ongoing feedback from users and stakeholders and continuously iterate based on evolving business and product needs. Keep engineering teams unblocked by providing clear requirements, timely decisions, and effective prioritization. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience as a Product Manager, ideally within B2B SaaS, HR Tech, enterprise software, or other complex digital products. Strong experience creating PRDs, user stories, user flows, acceptance criteria, and product specifications. Strong product sense with experience designing or reviewing B2B and administrative interfaces. Good understanding of complex workflows, data-dense tables, permissions, bulk actions, and role-based user experiences. Hands-on experience with Figma and the ability to effectively participate in product and design reviews. Experience working in Agile product development environments using Jira, Linear, or comparable tools. Practical experience conducting UAT, feature testing, validation, and product sign-offs. Strong systems-thinking skills and a working understanding of RBAC, permissions, and administrative data structures. summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holding - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership - 401k Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. Summit Wash Holdings shares the mission to consistently create memorable experiences, living by the mantra “One Wash, One Way.” Guided by the vision to set the industry standard where professional execution meets personal fulfillment, our company is built on a foundation of values that inspire excellence. What do we need? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be confident in getting dirty to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, friendly personality, and have excellent communication skills - bilingual a plus! All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service!
